function.name: Write
function.description: Write full file content into the keeper sandbox or an allowed path. Missing parent directories are created safely; call Write directly instead of using Execute mkdir.

file_path.description: Absolute or sandbox-relative file path. Parent directories are created as needed.

content.description: Exact full file content; overwrites the existing file. Preserve requested whitespace, including a final newline when requested. Do not strip or add whitespace. Compare bytes_written with the expected UTF-8 byte count; verify file content or hash before claiming exact content.
